opportunities.name: Double Pass Charge Heal
opportunities.objective: Log two shield passes and Helia consumption per pass.
opportunities.mechanic: W shields allies on outward and return passes. Q/E champion damage can preload Helia before W, while Staff gives AP/haste on allied shielding; AP improves both shield passes. Q immobilization can supply Mandate vulnerability to support the ally's damage.
opportunities.requiredState: An ally intersects both W paths after champion damage and Q hits for Mandate.
opportunities.failure: Return path misses the ally or charges were already consumed.
opportunities.test: Log two shield passes and Helia consumption per pass; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Two shield passes do not prove two full independent Helia heals.

opportunities.name: Spark Mark Reload
opportunities.objective: Count marks consumed during Q-attack-R-attack sequence.
opportunities.mechanic: P says R consumes existing Illumination and refreshes it. Q/root enables an attack before R and a second attack after R; Lich Bane/Nashor reward the risky short-range weave while Cosmic/E slow can preserve access. AP keeps R and mark damage relevant.
opportunities.requiredState: Target survives first attack/R and Lux can safely reach for refreshed mark.
opportunities.failure: Approaching for two attacks forfeits range advantage or the target dies before the second mark.
opportunities.test: Count marks consumed during Q-attack-R-attack sequence; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R refresh does not grant unlimited marks or free attack resets.

ruledOut.reason: R is AP magic with explicit passive mark behavior, not an ordinary critical attack.

unknowns: R/P event ordering and Lich Bane availability across rapid casts need live logs.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Return path misses the ally or charges were already consumed.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Two shield passes do not prove two full independent Helia heals.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Staff of Flowing Water, Imperial Mandate, Rabadon's Deathcap, Redemption, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
